name: trait-S03-crest-a
refs: Our signed young S03, Tuikis (project-owned): the creature, exactly. Its teal spots on the pale body are the 'spots' look.
prompt: Paint THREE panels side by side, equal size, a small gap between them, on plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no borders, no text. All three show the SAME creature as the reference (same teal head, round ears, big teal eyes, same brush and soft painterly light from the top left) in the SAME framing: a medium close-up of the head and shoulders, three-quarter view as in the reference, with clear magenta above the head. Only the crest on top of the head changes. LEFT, 'low crest': a short low stalk, barely rising above the head. MIDDLE, 'between': exactly the reference's thin stalk with its small round tip. RIGHT, 'tall crest': the same stalk twice as tall, still thin, with its small round tip. Face, ears, eyes, pose, size and light identical. No props, no ground, no shadow, no glow.
